# @ntgovernment/web-design-tokens — Copilot Instructions

This repository is a standalone npm package that extracts and exports design tokens from the NT Government web design system.

## Package purpose

- **Source of truth**: `tokens.json` (849 tokens, ~110 KB, exported from Figma)
- **CSS output**: 9 files in `dist/css/` (shared layers) and `dist/css/themes/` (theme files) — generated by `scripts/build-tokens.js`
- **JS/TS output**: `dist/index.{mjs,cjs,d.ts}` — generated by `scripts/generate-js-tokens.js`
- **Package name**: `@ntgovernment/web-design-tokens`
- **Registry**: GitHub Packages (`https://npm.pkg.github.com`)

## Critical conventions

### Never edit generated files manually
All files in `dist/` are auto-generated. Changes must be made in `tokens.json` or the build scripts, then regenerated:

```bash
npm run build          # validate + generate CSS + generate JS/TS
npm run tokens:build   # CSS only
npm run build:js       # JS/TS only
```

### Path conventions
- Token source: `tokens.json` (root) — never `design-tokens/tokens.json`
- CSS output: `dist/css/` for shared layers, `dist/css/themes/` for theme files — never `css/` or `src/themes/`
- JS output: `dist/` (alongside CSS)

### Encoding
All files must be UTF-8. **Never use PowerShell `Set-Content` or `Get-Content` to modify `.js` or `.css` files** — it corrupts non-ASCII characters (emojis, arrows) into mojibake. Use Node.js `fs.readFileSync` / `fs.writeFileSync` with `"utf-8"` encoding, or the editor tools directly.

## Token structure (tokens.json)

Top-level keys: `primitives`, `themes`, `grid`, `font`, `effect`

| Key | Content |
|-----|---------|
| `primitives.ntg` | NTG brand colours (13 groups: blue, orange, ochre, …) |
| `primitives.central` | Central theme colours (8 groups) |
| `themes.ntg` | Semantic tokens: `clr`, `type`, `radii`, `sp`, `border-width` |
| `themes.central` | Same structure, different values |
| `grid.ntg-breakpoint` | 5 breakpoints: xs-575, sm-767, md-991, lg-1199, xl-1200 |
| `font.ntg-type` | Desktop typography scale (heading, body, link, caption, …) |
| `font.ntg-type-sm` | Mobile typography scale |
| `effect.ntg-shadow` | Shadow tokens: sm, sm-top, md, md-top, lg, lg-top + focus states |

## JS exports

```ts
import { colors, spacing, typography, shadows, borders, grid } from '@ntgovernment/web-design-tokens';
```

- `colors.ntg` — primitive NTG colours keyed by group then shade
- `colors.central` — primitive Central colours
- `colors.status` — info/success/warning/danger
- `spacing` — keyed by `xxs | xs | sm | md | lg | xl | xxl | xxxl` (values in px)
- `typography` — keyed by category (heading, body, link, …) then variant then property
- `shadows` — keyed by name (sm, sm-top, md, …) → CSS box-shadow string
- `borders.widths` — keyed by size (sm, md, lg, xl, xxl) → px value
- `borders.radii` — keyed by size (none, button, sm, md, lg) → px value
- `grid` — keyed by breakpoint name → object with gutterSize, count, offset, sectionSize

## CSS layers (import order matters)

```
dist/css/common.css → dist/css/grid.css → dist/css/typography.css → dist/css/typography-literals.css → dist/css/themes/theme-ntg.css (or theme-central.css)
```

Importing a theme file is sufficient — it contains `@import` statements for the layers above it (using `../` relative paths since themes live in the `themes/` subdirectory).

## Custom prompts

Two slash-command prompts are available in `.github/prompts/`:

| Command | File | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| `/update-documentation` | `update-documentation.prompt.md` | Update README, inline comments, and JSDoc throughout the package |
| `/deploy-to-dev` | `deploy-to-dev.prompt.md` | Stage, version-bump, commit with conventional message, push to `origin/dev` |

## Scripts

| Script | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `scripts/build-tokens.js` | ~1600 lines; reads `tokens.json`, writes 9 CSS files to `css/` |
| `scripts/validate-tokens.js` | Validates `tokens.json` structure and reports statistics |
| `scripts/generate-js-tokens.js` | Reads `tokens.json`, writes `dist/index.{mjs,cjs,d.ts}` |
